notes: A new player layout. Under the title, the source you are watching from; time pills at both ends of the scrubber, the right one switching between time left and total; one centred toolbar with icons for Next, Subtitles, Audio, Quality, Speed, Sleep and Party; the clock and the end time top right. Subtitles open a full panel: languages with counts, each language's tracks and where they came from, timing and appearance alongside. On the TV: an icon-only rail, a full-bleed featured board and title pages, row sources under the row names, bigger stream cards.
